messages:
Rae Thompson: Starting a whats-new draft for the runtime tweak: new batching presets + KV-cache housekeeping. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5256
Diego Morales: Drop the TL;DR bullets here and I'll add SDK snippets and copyedit.
Rae Thompson: TL;DR: 1) New presets: fast-path, throughput-plus, eco-mode-1. 2) KV cache housekeeping to lower memory and improve prefix reuse. 3) Router preference: favor same-region replicas to cut p99. 4) Known caveat: brief metric dip during KV eviction/warmup window; canary dashboards might show lower-than-actual latency until caches stabilize.
Ava Kim: For migration note: mention that customers using custom batching should trial presets in staging and enable via route config. Also add dedicated pool pin example.
Diego Morales: I'll add concise SDK examples (Python + Node) and where to place them in the PR. Python draft:
```
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
c.routes.update('order-route', batching_preset='fast-path')
```
Node draft:
```
await client.routes.update('order-route', { batchingPreset: 'fast-path' })
```
Rae Thompson: Nice. Ava, suggested pool example: `poolConfig: { batchingPreset: 'throughput-plus' }` and note to recycle long-lived workers so the preset takes effect.
Ava Kim: Added that and a 3-step QA checklist: smoke test in staging, run p99 ramp, monitor canary for 20m.
release-bot: Reminder: add a whats-new markdown under /docs/whats-new with frontmatter: 
```
---
date: 2025-06-15
title: "Batching presets + KV housekeeping"
components: [runtime, routing]
---
```
Rae Thompson: Thanks all. Any objections to merging after editorial pass + CI? I will schedule the publish for 09:00 PDT and ping eng-oncall at merge for the first 30m.
Diego Morales: LGTM from docs side. Will push the SDK snippets into the PR now.
Ava Kim: :white_check_mark: Merge after CI.
